title: Scheduling: Online Booking and the Waitlist | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Customers book appointments at any hour when your site shows them only the times that are really free. The Scheduling module for Orchard Core gives each appointment type a public booking page, a private link to move or cancel, and a waitlist for times that are taken.

This video shows how to turn online booking on, what the customer sees, and how the waitlist works.

In this video:
• Why online booking, and what stays under your control
• Turning it on: the Scheduling Self-Service feature and the booking page address
• What the customer sees: choosing a day and time, the Your appointment page, moving and cancelling
• Appointment types that wait for confirmation
• The waitlist: adding a customer, and notifying the one who waited longest when a time frees up
• Telling customers by email with a workflow
